en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural village surrounded by trees and fields. In the middle distance stand wooden houses and farm buildings, with a tall church tower rising above the settlement. The scene is labeled in printed text at the bottom, and there are small handwritten numeric marks (1. and 2.) over buildings in the image, plus a handwritten number in the lower left margin.
